newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Feb 25.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Feb 25.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi British Bank ratifies a $93 million dividend to shareholders for 1996.
- Yemen, Egypt to sign an agreement of cooperation in gas and oil sector on Tuesday.
- Around 13 percent of Jordan's total imports in 1996 were oil.
- Gulf Investment Corporation made $122.9 net profit in 1996.
- Net profit of Morocco's Foreign Trade Bank may reach $40 million in 1996, bankers say.
- Saudi team in Jordan to exmaine investment opportunities.
